# Takkar (playtakkar.in)

> Takkar is a free daily quiz duel for people in India preparing for government exams: SSC CGL, SSC CHSL, SSC GD, IBPS PO, IBPS RRB (PO and Clerk), RRB NTPC and RRB Group D. Each duel is ten quant and reasoning questions in the chosen exam's pattern, marking and timing, against a rival or a friend, with step-by-step solutions. Tutors and coaching centres can get verified and run a private league for each batch. Takkar is for adults (18 and over) and has no cash prizes, betting or paid contests.

Takkar is in beta. It runs in any browser and as an Android app. It is independent and not affiliated with any exam-conducting organisation; for official exam dates and notices, see ssc.gov.in, ibps.in and the regional RRB websites.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://www.playtakkar.in/): what Takkar is, how a duel works, squads, Plus, questions and answers
- [Play in the browser](https://www.playtakkar.in/play/): the web app, free, no download
- [Android app](https://www.playtakkar.in/beta): download, install steps and the file's SHA-256 fingerprint
- [Practice questions with solutions](https://www.playtakkar.in/practice): 19 quant and reasoning topics for SSC, bank and railway exams, from percentages, simple and compound interest and quadratic equations to syllogism, inequalities, blood relations and direction sense
- [Question of the day](https://www.playtakkar.in/question-of-the-day): a new solved question every day; [every earlier question](https://www.playtakkar.in/question-of-the-day/archive)
- [For tutors and coaching centres](https://www.playtakkar.in/tutors): leagues for each batch, getting verified, the free beta plan

## Exam patterns Takkar follows

Full guides ([all exams](https://www.playtakkar.in/exams)): [SSC CGL Tier 1](https://www.playtakkar.in/ssc-cgl), [SSC CHSL Tier 1](https://www.playtakkar.in/ssc-chsl), [SSC GD Constable](https://www.playtakkar.in/ssc-gd), [IBPS PO Prelims](https://www.playtakkar.in/ibps-po), [IBPS RRB PO and Clerk Prelims](https://www.playtakkar.in/ibps-rrb), [RRB NTPC CBT 1](https://www.playtakkar.in/rrb-ntpc), [RRB Group D CBT](https://www.playtakkar.in/rrb-group-d)

In Hindi: [all Hindi guides](https://www.playtakkar.in/hi), one for each exam

- SSC CGL Tier 1: +2 for a right answer, −0.5 for a wrong one, about 36 seconds a question
- IBPS PO prelims: a quarter of the question’s marks off for a wrong answer, 20 minutes for each of the three sections
- RRB NTPC CBT 1: +1 right, −⅓ wrong, about 54 seconds a question
- SSC CHSL Tier 1: +2 / −0.5, 36 seconds a question, 15 minutes for each section
- SSC GD Constable: +2 / −0.25, 80 questions in 60 minutes, 45 seconds a question
- IBPS RRB PO and Clerk prelims: +1 / −0.25, 80 questions in 45 minutes (Reasoning 25, Quant 20)
- RRB Group D: +1 / −⅓, 100 questions in 90 minutes, 54 seconds a question
